## Wakt 1.0.10

### Streak wallpaper, rebuilt
The goal wallpaper is now a live wallpaper instead of a replaced image. That fixes the jump to the home screen on every check-in (replacing the wallpaper image restarts some launchers) and lets it redraw instantly after each check-in and at midnight.

New look: each goal shows its title, a flame with the streak number and "DAY STREAK", and a GitHub-style day-by-day grid of the last weeks (kept days in blue, slipped days in red, today outlined), on a dark glow. The Goals tab shows a live preview and a "Set as wallpaper" button that opens the system picker, where you choose home screen, lock screen or both.

Nothing is drawn when the screen is off, and nothing leaves the device.
